name: Sunset Delight
review:
A simple three-reel, five-line game with wilds, scatters and free spins. That's really all there is to it.

It's for players who want old-school fruit-machine simplicity rather than a stack of features to learn. Low volatility, a 413x cap and a 96.3% RTP keep sessions steady, but don't expect anything big to happen. A nice break from the busier slots in the catalogue.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
